Macrons

Consonantal i

Household, washing & chores

rubbish bin noun

also bin, dustbin, garbage can

modern

M-O s.v. garbage can, after Egger

excipulum pūrgāmentārium

Lewis & Short has only the plural excipula, receptacles.

Examples

  • Hoc in excipulum abjice.

    Throw this in the bin.composed

See also rubbish, wastebasket.

SourcesLewis & Short: excipula

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. clean house, clean up, tidy up, broom: dustpan, garbage, trash, garbage can, waste basket. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): pp. 38, 39, 290, 292, 307, 320, 401, 404.

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
